newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists mixed on AEX outlook.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists mixed on AEX outlook.

text.p: Dutch chartists were mixed on the outlook for the AEX stock market index on Monday, with some predicting near-term weakness but others only a minor correction before the bull-run continued.
The AEX index Friday last week down 13.65 points, or 1.70 percent, on the day at 790.97 points. By midsession on Monday, the index had climbed back above the 800-point level.

"In a worst case scenario, the AEX index could test horizontal support in the 775 range. However, any dip should provide a nice buying opportunity, given strong long-term technicals," said ING Barings.
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance

MeesPierson -- The consequesnces of the French elections and the German gold problems support us in our pessimestic view for the near future. Furthermore the chart of the Dow looks rather bad. The Dow crossed its long-term support level downwards and with this move the Dow left its upward trading range. The Dow is preparing for a fall to at least 7,000. The difficulties facing EMU will cause an increase in the dollar. The chart shows us a dollar in upwards trading range with support around 1.89.

ING Barings -- The fall of the AEX out of the rising trend channel has weakened its short-term technicals. Money flow has formed a top, indicating some selling pressure. But the advance/decline line remains bullish, showing that leadership in the market is still intact. The 12-day call/put ratio is still far below its danger levels, suggesting only limited downside potential for the AEX. All in all the charts indicate a minor correction phase for the Amsterdam stock market. In a worst case scenario the AEX could test horizontal support in the 775 range. However, any dip should provide a nice buying opportunity, given strong long-term technicals.
